name: Audio Recognition (Listen and Identify)
summary: Audio plays. User selects correct identification from options.

aiGenerability.notes: Requires audio asset library. AI designs questions and identifies which audio to pair, but sourcing or synthesizing audio requires external tools (text-to-speech, audio databases, or licensed recordings). Can auto-generate audio from text using TTS for pronunciation practice.

prompt.description: Text instruction describing what the learner should listen for (e.g., 'Which instrument is playing?').

audioUrl.description: URL or path to the audio file (MP3, WAV, OGG).

options.description: Array of answer options (2-4 items) for the learner to choose from.

correctIndex.description: 0-based index of the correct answer in the options array.

explanation.description: Optional explanation of the correct answer and how to distinguish it.

difficulty.description: Difficulty level based on audio distinctiveness.

ux.animation: play-button ripple, answer buttons highlight on tap
ux.mobileNotes: Large play button (64x64px) centered at top. Audio controls (play, replay, volume) easily accessible. Answer options stacked below as full-width buttons.

ageAdaptations.8-10: Simple, distinct sounds (animal calls, instruments, voice). 2-3 options only. Large play button with speaker icon. Unlimited replays encouraged. Longer audio clips (5-10 seconds) to allow processing. Clear, labeled options.
ageAdaptations.11-13: More subtle audio distinctions (similar instruments, accents in speech). 3 options. Standard play button. Limited replays (3-5 allowed, counter visible). Audio shorter (3-7 seconds).
ageAdaptations.14-16: Challenging audio (similar languages, musical style distinctions, subtle pronunciation differences). 3-4 options. Timed variant (15-20s per item). Single or limited replay. Expert-level explanation with linguistic or musical detail.
